rent: Weighted household medians of positive gross rent; all move-in years; 80 replicate weights; no geographic fallback.
space: HHSIZE joined to BEDROOMS by CONTROL; positive full-sample weights; 80 replicate ratios; minimum 30 responses and CV at most 0.30.
reuse: NYC Rent Seekers figures and documentation: MIT. Third-party source data retains its source terms.
